description: Recognition analytics page (new RecognitionAnalyticsSection added to existing analytics page). Depends on FEAT-001 (DB types). Independent of FEATs 005-006.
steps: 1. Read src/app/(app)/pulse/analytics/page.tsx and src/app/(app)/pulse/analytics/layout.tsx to understand the current analytics page structure. The current page.tsx exports LeadershipDashboard — a server component.

2. Read src/features/pulse/analytics/components/LeadershipDashboard.tsx in full (already read during exploration — it renders check-in rate, goals, flight risks, dept breakdown). Read src/features/pulse/surveys/components/SurveyDistributionChart.tsx (bar chart taking { label, count }[] data).

3. Create src/features/pulse/analytics/components/RecognitionAnalyticsSection.tsx (server component, async function):
  Props: `{ since: Date; departmentFilter?: string; campaignId?: string }`

  Queries (all via supabaseAdmin):
  a. Top 5 givers: SELECT from_user_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM feedback WHERE visibility='public' AND created_at >= since [AND campaign_id = campaignId if set] GROUP BY from_user_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
  b. Top 5 receivers: JOIN feedback_recipients fr ON fr.feedback_id = f.id → SELECT fr.user_id, COUNT(*) as cnt GROUP BY fr.user_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
     (Use: supabaseAdmin.from('feedback_recipients').select('user_id, feedback:feedback_id(created_at, visibility, campaign_id)') with filters)
     Simpler: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM feedback_recipients WHERE feedback_id IN (SELECT id FROM feedback WHERE visibility='public' AND created_at >= since) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 5
     Use raw rpc or two queries: fetch feedback IDs first, then count feedback_recipients.
  c. Value distribution: SELECT v.name, COUNT(f.id) as cnt FROM recognition_values v LEFT JOIN feedback f ON f.value_id = v.id AND f.created_at >= since WHERE v.is_active = true GROUP BY v.id, v.name ORDER BY cnt DESC
     Use: supabaseAdmin.from('recognition_values').select('id, name, color').eq('is_active', true) then supabaseAdmin.from('feedback').select('value_id').eq('visibility','public').gte('created_at', since.toISOString()) and count by value_id in TS.
  d. Weekly trend (last 8 weeks): fetch feedback rows with created_at >= 8 weeks ago, group by ISO week in TS.
  e. Cross-team reach: SELECT DISTINCT u.department FROM feedback_recipients fr JOIN users u ON u.id = fr.user_id WHERE fr.feedback_id IN (SELECT id FROM feedback WHERE ...) — count distinct departments.

  Render:
  - StatCards row: total public recognition sent (last period), unique givers, unique receivers, cross-team reach (dept count)
  - 'Top givers' list: top 5 with rank, name, count (same Board pattern as LeaderboardsPage)
  - 'Top receivers' list: same
  - 'Value distribution' bar chart: use SurveyDistributionChart from src/features/pulse/surveys/components/SurveyDistributionChart.tsx (reuse existing component, pass { label: value.name, count: cnt }[])
  - 'Recognition trend' area chart: 8-week trend — reuse PulseAnalyticsCharts pattern with a simple AreaChart from recharts (client component wrapper needed).

  For the area chart, create a small client component RecognitionTrendChart.tsx in the same folder:
```typescript
'use client';
import { Area, AreaChart, CartesianGrid, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from 'recharts';
export function RecognitionTrendChart({ data }: { data: { week: string; count: number }[] }) { ... }
```

  Department filter and campaign filter are passed as props from the page — the page handles filter state via searchParams (not client state).

4. Create src/features/pulse/analytics/components/RecognitionAnalyticsFilters.tsx (client component):
  - Props: `{ departments: string[]; campaigns: { id: string; name: string }[]; currentRange: string; currentDept: string; currentCampaign: string }`
  - Renders three selects: date range (last 30d / last 90d / all), department, campaign
  - On change, updates URL searchParams using `useRouter` and `useSearchParams` — pushes new URL via router.push('/pulse/analytics?' + new params.toString()). This triggers server re-render of the page with new props.

5. Create src/features/pulse/analytics/components/RecognitionAnalyticsPage.tsx (server component):
  - Props: `{ searchParams: { range?: string; dept?: string; campaign?: string } }` (Next.js 16 pattern: searchParams comes from page props)
  - Auth: getServerSession; if !can(role, 'view_analytics') redirect('/pulse')
  - Parse since date from range param: '30d' → 30 days ago, '90d' → 90 days ago, default → epoch (all time)
  - Fetch departments list, campaigns list (for filter dropdowns)
  - Render SetPageHeader title='Recognition Analytics' icon='solar:graph-new-up-broken'
  - Render RecognitionAnalyticsFilters (client) with current filter values
  - Render RecognitionAnalyticsSection (server) with computed since date + filters
acceptance_criteria: src/app/(app)/pulse/analytics/page.tsx renders both LeadershipDashboard and RecognitionAnalyticsPage and handles searchParams as a Promise
